_comment: LEVEL 4 (component, frontend): reusable table with pagination/sorting/loading. Uses [[ ]] delimiters so it never collides with JS template syntax.
name: comp-paginated-table
description: Reusable React table: pagination, column sorting, loading + empty states. Place in src/components/.
notes: Usage: <PaginatedTable columns={[{key,label,sortable}]} rows={items} total={100} page={1} pageSize={20} onPageChange={setPage} onSort={setSort} loading={loading} />. Self-contained, no extra deps.
